name: Off Register
desc: Pulls true subtractive cyan, magenta and yellow separations out of the live frame and lets the press slip — every plate wandering on its own orbit and creeping a hair off-size, paper showing in the gaps, the key plate landing late as dot gain, cylinder banding rolling through, hickeys printing rings, and the register targets in the margin visibly refusing to agree.

offset.doc: how far out of register the plates run — separation drift and plate creep

gain.doc: key plate weight and dot gain — how much the darks fatten and how heavy the black lands

energy.doc: press vigour — drift amplitude, cylinder banding depth, how hard the hickeys print

density.doc: banding frequency around the cylinder and how many hickeys are on the blanket

speed.doc: rate multiplier on the wander, the banding roll and the creep

hue.doc: stock hue — the paper the inks are printing onto

marks.doc: register targets and the colour control bar in the trim — 0 hides the furniture

slur.doc: one plate smearing along the cylinder direction

scale.doc: size of the marks, bar, hickeys and band spacing

x.doc: registration pivot — the point the plates still agree on, x

alpha.doc: overall strength of the pass — under 100 the un-slipped frame ghosts through as doubling

act.doc: multi-minute program: a normal run drifting in and out / makeready, nearly on register / the register crashes wide open and slowly comes back

style.doc: aesthetic: four-colour offset on white stock / absorbent yellowed newsprint with heavy dot gain and bleed / two inks only, running wide / the inks trap badly and the overprints go muddy / progressive proof — the plates pulled apart on the bench as three single-ink panels beside the four-colour

seed.doc: deterministic press — which plate slurs, orbit phases, hickey placement
